blocks.text: Lawyers for world number one Alexander Zverev have told the BBC he will defend himself against a fresh action which alleges he misrepresented the outcome of his domestic abuse trial. Former partner Brenda Patea is seeking damages and an injunction against him making similar comments in future. In October 2023 Zverev was issued with a penalty order for bodily harm against Patea, with whom he has a daughter.
